# 01 · Discord Server Blueprint

Every category and channel that `npm run setup-server` creates, in the order it creates them.
Administrators can see and moderate every channel. Moderators can additionally see every channel that Verified Members can see.
Channels marked "bot" give the economy bot access to post reports, panels or logs.

## START HERE

## TICKETS

Private ticket channels are created here automatically by the bot (one channel per ticket). Only the member who opened the ticket, the responsible team, Administrators and the bot can see a ticket. See "Ticket types" below.

## Ticket types

Ticket buttons are posted with `npm run post-messages -- --apply` (or `/panel`).

| Button | Panel channel | Reviewed by (besides Administrators) |
|---|---|---|
| ❓ General help | #support | Support Team, Moderator |
| 🛠️ Technical problem | #support | Support Team, Developer |
| 🔒 Exploit / security issue | #support | Developer |
| 🚩 Report a player | #player-reports | Moderator |
| ⚖️ Appeal a decision | #appeals | Moderator (also open to Restricted Members) |
| 🚓 City Police | #faction-applications | City Police Command |
| 🛡️ Gendarmerie | #faction-applications | Gendarmerie Command |
| 🎖️ Land Forces / Air Force | #faction-applications | Armed Forces Command |
| 🦅 Revolutionary Guard | #faction-applications | Revolutionary Guard Command |
| 🚑 EMS | #faction-applications | EMS Command |
| 🚒 Brandwehr | #faction-applications | Brandwehr Command |
| 📜 Justice (lawyer, prosecutor, judge) | #faction-applications | Judge, Secretary for Internal Affairs and Infrastructure |
| 🏛️ Civil service / government | #faction-applications | Secretary-General, Secretary for Internal Affairs and Infrastructure |
| 📄 AVK insurance officer | #faction-applications | Secretary for Economy and Education |
| 🧑‍💼 Staff team (out of character) | #faction-applications | Administrators only |
| 🏢 Question to the business registry | #business-registration | Secretary for Economy and Education, Government Official, Economic Administrator |
| 🏛️ File a case / request a lawyer | #legal-information | Judge, Justice |

Rules for all tickets: at most 3 open tickets per member; closing a ticket hides it from the member; only Administrators and the bot can delete a closed ticket, and a transcript is saved to #ticket-transcripts first.

## Panels

- **Support** (#support): Open a private ticket. Only you and the responsible team can see it.
- **Player reports** (#player-reports): Report a rule violation privately. Include evidence.
- **Appeals** (#appeals): Appeal a moderation decision. Stay factual and respectful.
- **Applications** (#faction-applications): Choose the institution you want to apply to. A private application channel opens for you and the responsible command.
- **Business registry** (#business-registration): Register with `/business register` in #bank-terminal. Questions? Open a ticket.
- **Legal services** (#legal-information): File a case, appeal a judgment or request a lawyer.
- **Verification** (#verify): "I accept the rules" button. Gives Verified Member and New Member.
- **Civilian** (#start-here): button to add or remove the Civilian role.
